text:
I don't have a price adjustment policy in the information I can see, so I can't say whether Leafy refunds the difference when a price drops after you buy. I don't want to guess and give you the wrong answer.

If you have a specific order in mind, send me the order number (it looks like LF-123456) and I can pass it to a Support Lead to review. You can also email help@leafy.example, which is answered within 1 business day.

If you'd rather not keep the item, non-living items can be returned within 30 days of delivery if they're unused and in original packaging.
